findings.finding: The previous coarse plan placed semantic completion before the v2 profile binding it needs.
findings.resolution: Gap numbers are review topics, not execution order. Prepare meanings first; prepare profile/contract/prototype compatibility; obtain exact decisions once all reviewable inputs exist. The work-item DAG separates preparation from application.

findings.finding: The source reader binds mutable registry equality to the D74 immutable vocabulary epoch.
findings.resolution: G09.02 prepares an explicit successor reader/profile before any authorized registry change. Never disable equality/freshness checks.

findings.finding: Method Binding/v1 is a specialized Craft contract, despite the general Method Definition.
findings.resolution: G04.06 selects a compatible representation rather than assuming the carrier is generic.

findings.finding: Local governance emits one owner boundary and uses the operator owner for both role and principal.
findings.resolution: G07.07/G07.08 bind actual independent roles/principals/scopes, with explicit protocol versioning.

findings.finding: Generic record validation walks relation_refs; Definition/v2 exposes typed_relations.
findings.resolution: G07.05 adds explicit Definition source/consumer/typed endpoint obligations; G09.04 maps lawful graph visibility.

findings.finding: The operational Challenge Contract does not explicitly list Definition as a challengeable subject kind.
findings.resolution: G07.04 selects an applicable admitted contract or prepares a bounded owner-reviewed successor.

findings.finding: Existing Product/Thesis identity and governed-knowledge capability are already available as admitted source selections.
findings.resolution: G02.01 reuses the existing Lab Product/Thesis; G02.02 resolves ownership rather than inventing or borrowing a Craft-only assignment.

findings.finding: The admitted prototype-first construction invariant requires current product-test evidence and eligibility for Product approval before separate authority requests.
findings.resolution: G10.02/G10.03 precede G10.05; early semantic review packages remain prepared candidates, not premature runtime authority.
